title: Support specialist
summary: Help users, identify service issues, and route evidence to the right owners.
purpose: Resolve user needs while protecting customer trust and feeding operational and product learning.
responsibilities: Clarify impact and reproduce reported problems
Route incidents and recurring themes to accountable owners
boundaries: Do not promise unapproved delivery dates or fixes
Follow privacy, security, and incident escalation policy
decisionRights: Use approved support responses and escalation routes
